installGuideIntro.message: Follow these steps to set up your first timer and understand key controls.

installGuideStep1.message: Pin Auto Tab Timer to your toolbar so it is always one click away.

installGuideStep2.message: Open the tab you want to manage, then open the extension popup.

installGuideStep3.message: Enter hours, minutes, and seconds, then click Start Timer.

installGuideStep4.message: Choose completion action: Close tab or Notify me only.

installGuideStep5.message: Use Pause, Resume, Reset, or Cancel from the active timer card as needed.

installGuideStep6.message: Open Settings to choose your default completion action and notification behavior.

installGuideTip1.message: 00:00:00 is invalid. The extension shows an inline error and prevents start.

installGuideTip2.message: Use whole numbers for hours, minutes, and seconds when starting a timer.

installGuideTip3.message: Notify me only always sends a notification and keeps the tab open.

installGuideTip4.message: Close tab action can send notifications based on your notification toggle.

installGuidePrivacy.message: No account is required. Settings and timer state are stored in your browser extension storage.

updateGuideHeading.message: How to Use What's New in 1.3.0

updateGuideIntro.message: Use this quick guide to apply the 1.3.0 changes in your normal timer workflow.

updateGuideStep1.message: Enter your timer duration as usual, then start the timer.

updateGuideStep2.message: If the total time is 00:00:00, you will now see an inline error. Enter a valid duration, then start again.

updateGuideStep3.message: Set the completion action directly on each timer card, or set your default action in Settings.

updateGuideStep4.message: Use Notify me only when you want a reminder but need the tab to stay open.

updateGuideStep5.message: Use Close tab when you want the tab cleaned up automatically after countdown ends.

updateGuideStep6.message: Manage running timers with Pause, Resume, Reset, and Cancel exactly as before.

updateGuideTip1.message: Notify me only always sends a notification and never closes the tab.

updateGuideTip2.message: Close tab behavior still follows your notification toggle.

updateGuideTip3.message: No data migration is required for 1.3.0.

updateGuideTip4.message: If you test locales with ?locale=xx, the override affects onboarding pages only.
